name: Science Careers in Search of Women (SCSW)
org: Argonne National Laboratory (Women in Science and Technology)
what_you_do: An all-day conference at Argonne for high school girls. Meet more than 50 women scientists and engineers, join career panels, look at research posters and take career and leadership quizzes.
pay_detail: The page does not say if there is a cost.
deadline_text: No date posted. The page still says to check back for 2025 registration, so the next date is not known.
how_to_apply: Watch the event page for registration to open.
notes: The page has not been updated since the 2025 event, so ask Argonne Education if it is running: education@anl.gov. The season is our guess, not from the page.
